metadata.description: Documentation explaining Docker, containers, and how it could help PostSpark development environment
metadata.context: Explains Docker and its potential use in PostSpark

metadata.description: Container is an isolated environment with everything needed to run the application. Reduces 'works on my machine' problems
Dockerfile describes how to build the application image: base image, runtime version, dependency installation, build commands, start command
metadata.context: How to define a Docker image

metadata.description: docker-compose.yml describes multiple services running together: Node app, local database, cache, auxiliary services
metadata.context: How to run multiple containers together

metadata.description: Docker helps PostSpark by: fixing Node version, standardizing pnpm, facilitating onboarding, documenting project startup, reducing Windows/macOS/Linux differences, creating clearer CI/CD base
